GET /api/share/evidence/:token.note: A capability link a founder made for a reader outside Axal: no sign-in by design. The token is 32 random bytes stored only as a SHA-256 digest; one conditional UPDATE consumes a view only while the link is unrevoked, unexpired, under its view limit and its venture exists. Unknown, malformed, expired, used-up and revoked tokens are refused 404/410 with a page that names no venture and consumes nothing; the body is the pack frozen at creation from the founder's own preview projection. Only the venture's founders make, list or revoke links.

GET /api/share/readiness/:token.note: The readiness snapshot a founder made for a reader outside Axal (D6897): no sign-in by design, on the evidence pack's link store and rules. The token is 32 random bytes stored only as a SHA-256 digest; one conditional UPDATE consumes a view only while the link is unrevoked, unexpired, under its view limit, of output 'readiness' and its venture exists, so a pack token never opens here. Unknown, expired, used-up and revoked tokens are refused 404/410 with a page that names no venture; the body is the seven areas frozen at creation, with no overall score and no Product-market fit. Only the venture's founders make, list or revoke links.
